# Splash Php-Core

> Core library for building Splash Sync connectors in PHP

Splash Php-Core provides base classes, interfaces, and field systems for synchronizing data (Products, Orders, Customers, etc.) between applications and the Splash ecosystem.

## Documentation

Full documentation: docs/

## Key Concepts

### Local Class
Entry point for your connector. Implements `LocalClassInterface` at `Splash\Local\Local`.

### Objects
Data types that can be synchronized. Extend `AbstractObject`, use `IntelParserTrait`.

### Fields
Define what data can be synchronized using `FieldsFactory` fluent API.

### Widgets
Dashboard components. Extend `AbstractWidget`.

## Quick Start

```php
// Local Class: Splash\Local\Local
class Local implements LocalClassInterface
{
    public function parameters(): array
    {
        return array(
            "WsIdentifier" => "your-server-id",
            "WsEncryptionKey" => "your-key",
        );
    }
}

// Object: Splash\Local\Objects\ThirdParty
class ThirdParty extends AbstractObject
{
    use IntelParserTrait;
    use ThirdParty\CrudTrait;
    use ThirdParty\CoreTrait;
}
```

## Helpers

- PricesHelper - Price encoding with tax calculations
- ObjectsHelper - Object ID links (e.g., "123::ThirdParty")
- DatesHelper - Date formatting
- FilesHelper - File metadata
- ImagesHelper - Image metadata
- ListsHelper - Collection field operations
- InlineHelper - Array to JSON conversion

## Related Packages

- splash/toolkit - Development environment
- splash/php-bundle - Symfony integration
- splash/openapi - REST API connectors
- splash/metadata - PHP 8 attributes
